'''Vixx''' is a collector, a NPC that trades you items and weapons in exchange for [[trophy|trophies]].

*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Oola's Lab}} (level 1)
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
**{{NPC location|Trial of Zinn}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Shhh. No one tell [[Oola]] I'm down here. I am going to best her at golemancy by stealing her secrets right from underneath that smug nose of hers. Bring me 5 [[Golem Runestone]]s in exchange for:"''

During Trial of Zinn, before the trial:
:''"So what did Oola offer you for your testimony? Nothing? In that case, you may be the only one here not getting paid. Well, aside from Zinn, of course."''

After the trial:
:''"With Zinn exiled, that's one fewer competitor to worry about."''
